title: Equity Perp Volume Surges 17x as Chip Stocks Draw Crypto Traders
excerpt: Equity perp volume surged 17x to $250 billion in July as traders piled into chip and memory stocks on crypto venues.
content_html:
Stock perpetual futures are expanding fast on both centralized and decentralized crypto exchanges. Monthly equity perpetual volume on centralized venues jumped roughly 17 times between April and July 2026, according to CryptoQuant.

Semiconductor and memory names drive the centralized boom. Decentralized exchanges (DEXs) show a wider mix, with stocks, commodities, and equity indexes among their largest markets.

Memory Chip Names Now Lead Crypto Equity Volume

In its latest market report, CryptoQuant noted that monthly volume climbed from about $15 billion in April to nearly $250 billion in July. Growth between June and July alone reached 56%.

Binance handled close to $193 billion of the July total, or 76% of all activity. Gate posted the fastest monthly expansion at 308% and has grown every month since May.

Follow us on X to get the latest news as it happens

Notably, much of this activity is concentrated in semiconductor and memory-chip stocks. SanDisk (SNDK) was the most-traded equity across the venues tracked by CryptoQuant.

It accounted for roughly 57% of equity perpetual volume on HTX, 29% on Gate, and 27% on Binance. Volume also clustered in SOXL, a triple-leveraged semiconductor fund, SK Hynix, Micron, and memory names.

Perp DEXs Widen Beyond Crypto Assets

Decentralized venues spread activity more widely. Equities, commodities, and index contracts all rank in the top ten by 90-day volume.

"Perp DEXs are gradually evolving from crypto-only venues into a universal trading layer for a much broader range of liquid assets," CryptoRank said.

SpaceX (SPCX) was the most-traded non-crypto asset, trailing only Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), and Hyperliquid (HYPE) in trading volume. It drew $84.6 billion over 90 days, ahead of Solana (SOL) at $77 billion, according to CryptoRank data.

SK Hynix recorded $31.1 billion over the period. Oil followed at $29.1 billion, gold at $28.5 billion, and the S&P 500 at $26.9 billion.

Bitcoin still led with $543 billion in volume, ahead of Ethereum at $246 billion and Hyperliquid at $93.6 billion. Non-crypto markets accounted for roughly 17% of the volume across the ten largest contracts.

The shift builds on earlier growth in pre-IPO perpetuals, which reached about $12 billion in June.

content_html_zh:
股票永续期货在中心化和去中心化加密货币交易所上都在快速扩张。 根据 CryptoQuant 的数据，2026 年 4 月至 7 月期间，中心化场所的月度永续股票交易量增长了约 17 倍。

半导体和存储器名称推动了中心化热潮。 去中心化交易所（DEX）表现出更广泛的组合，其中股票、大宗商品和股指是其最大的市场。

存储芯片名称现在引领加密股票交易量

CryptoQuant 在其最新市场报告中指出，月交易量从 4 月份的约 150 亿美元攀升至 7 月份的近 2500 亿美元。 仅 6 月至 7 月间的增长就达到 56%。

币安 7 月份处理的交易总额接近 1,930 亿美元，占所有活动的 76%。 Gate 公布了最快的月度扩张，达到 308%，并且自 5 月份以来每个月都在增长。

在 X 上关注我们以获取最新消息

值得注意的是，此类活动大部分集中在半导体和存储芯片股票上。 SanDisk (SNDK) 是 CryptoQuant 追踪的交易场所中交易量最大的股票。

它约占 HTX 永续权益交易量的 57%，Gate 上的 29%，Binance 上的 27%。 成交量还集中在三重杠杆半导体基金 SOXL、SK 海力士、美光和内存品牌。

Perp DEX 的范围不仅仅限于加密资产

去中心化的场所可以更广泛地传播活动。 股票、大宗商品和指数合约均位列 90 天成交量前十名。

CryptoRank 表示：“Perp DEX 正在逐渐从仅限加密货币的场所发展成为更广泛的流动资产的通用交易层。”

SpaceX (SPCX) 是交易量最大的非加密资产，交易量仅次于比特币 (BTC)、以太坊 (ETH) 和 Hyperliquid (HYPE)。 根据 CryptoRank 数据，它在 90 天内吸纳了 846 亿美元，领先于 Solana (SOL) 的 770 亿美元。

SK 海力士在此期间录得 311 亿美元的收入。 其次是石油，为 291 亿美元，黄金为 285 亿美元，标准普尔 500 指数为 269 亿美元。

比特币仍然以 5430 亿美元的交易量领先，领先于以太坊（2460 亿美元）和 Hyperliquid（936 亿美元）。 非加密市场约占十大合约交易量的 17%。

这一转变建立在 IPO 前永续债券早期增长的基础上，6 月份达到约 120 亿美元。
